type: exit: LATCH-CLOSE, close a setup's open lots when its -2R per-setup latch fires (journal-only forward shadow, no trading change)
pre_registered_at: 2026-11-11 ~22:45 ET (research/bdi/1111/LATCH_CLOSE_PLAN.md, committed before the two-year read)
rule: Per (setup, session): when the existing per-setup -2R latch fires (setup's realised R from exits so far <= -2.0R; blocks new entries for the rest of the day, unchanged), every lot of that setup still open is closed at the close of the next 5-min bar after the latching exit's bar, at market (cost: 1c + 1 bp exit side; the entry cost stays as booked). Lots that exit on their own inside that next bar keep their own exit. Both sides, every setup, no side/family filter.
